Video name: What is the capital of the USA?
column7: Washington, D.C. has been the capital since 1800. D.C. stands for District of Columbia.

Video name: How many states does the USA have?
column7: Hawaii was the last state to join, in 1959.

Video name: Who was the first President of the USA?
column7: George Washington took office in 1789 and served two terms.

Video name: In which city is the Statue of Liberty?
column7: The statue was a gift from France, unveiled in 1886.

Video name: What is the largest US state by area?
column7: Alaska is more than twice the size of Texas.

Video name: On which date is US Independence Day?
column7: The Declaration of Independence was adopted on July 4 1776.

Video name: Which US state is made up entirely of islands?
column7: Hawaii is a chain of volcanic islands in the Pacific Ocean, about 3,800 km from mainland USA.

Video name: What is the national bird of the USA?
column7: The bald eagle has been on the Great Seal of the USA since 1782.

Video name: In which US state is the Grand Canyon?
column7: The Colorado River carved the Grand Canyon. It is about 1.8 km deep.

Video name: How many presidents' faces are carved on Mount Rushmore?
column7: The four are Washington, Jefferson, Theodore Roosevelt and Lincoln.
